card.summary: Gives an agent a private place to keep the files it works from, such as policies, forms and reports.
card.example: A grant team keeps its policy PDFs in one place. Knowledge search and document extraction read them from there.
cost: Billed for how much is stored each month, by how quickly the files need to be reached.
Reading and writing files adds a small charge each time.
needs: A decision on which files go here and who may add them.
A rule for how long files are kept and how they are removed.
card.safety: Files stay on the private network and are read through a managed identity, not keys. Only files added on purpose are stored.
card.billing: Per GB stored by access tier, plus per-operation charges.
card.note: Knowledge search and document extraction both list your documents in storage you control as a need, so this is what they build on.
